title: Bonsai means shaping a small tree for years, and a first class sends you home with one
alt: A small, spreading maple tree with a thick trunk and bright green leaves, growing in a shallow oval pot on a dark stand against a pale wall.

posts.facebook:
Imagine taking home a small tree you shaped yourself.

A bonsai is kept small and shaped by pruning, wiring and repotting, and the work carries on for years. Most people start with a beginners' workshop at a college or a botanic garden, where you style a tree and take it home. As last listed, a two-hour class at a US botanic garden was $44, and a one-day workshop at a UK college was £100.

After that, many people join a local bonsai society. Many societies welcome visitors and hold demonstrations for beginners.

What kind of tree would you like to grow?

How to start, and where to go → https://dontdieretired.com/list/learn-bonsai/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=things-to-do
